title: Jaguar OBD-II Trouble Codes
content:
Jaguar OBD-II Trouble Codes
Welcome to the Jaguar trouble codes listing page. Generally speaking the codes below apply to 1996-newer OBD-II Jaguar vehicles. Technically, the definitions and applications of each P1xxx code can differ from year to model. So to be 100% accurate you'll need to refer to a service repair manual specific to your year/model/engine configuration such as Jaguar Technical Information System (JTIS) or possibly AllDataDIY.
Other Jaguar-specific content on our site:
Jaguar "Generic" Trouble Codes
Trouble codes that start with P0, P2, P34, B0, C0, U0, or U3 are all considered "generic". That is, the codes apply to all manufacturers. As such, those codes are not listed on this page. Choose the code section below to browse all those codes:
